This community is honestly kind of disgusting. I don't understand how people can come here just to ask for more and more, when there are only 3 or 4 people in the entire thread actually leaking content. At least have the decency to thank them for sharing it.

Cut the bullshit and start sharing more content! Enough with the prudishness and moral grandstanding. If you're so damn moral, stop using e-hentai and actually pay the artists for their work. Otherwise, start sharing more without being so afraid, because the hypocrisy here is honestly embarrassing.
